description: Fork of exp209 (E=192, qk_dim=64, val_bpb=1.7991 @ 8K, 59M). Single change: V2D smooth_mode True -> False. With smooth=False the V2D uses STE: hard ±1 forward, soft (rational) backward. Q/K/V are then linear projections of binary pair-difference signs, mimicking the binary-attention regime of exp183.
